propositions: Blocking edges written under the old ticket-type-tier rule are now wrong under the structural rule and never self-heal, distorting ready, next-batch and the parent-first claim cascade.

A read-only store-wide scan classifies each net-active blocking edge by calling the shipped resolver, marking edges ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, unreadable, or clean, and an opt-in --repair fixes them.

Repair writes the replacement LINK before UNLINK so any interruption leaves a resumable superset rather than losing a dependency; ambiguous pairs and closed/cyclic replacements are reported unrepairable and left in place.

run_repair self-deadlocked by holding the tracker write lock across its loop while each inner write re-acquired the same non-reentrant lock, causing zero progress; the fix drops the outer lock so each write locks per item.

Live remediation of this tracker repaired 12 of 18 bad edges; the 8 residual mis-escalated edges cannot be repaired because add_dependency refuses links whose source is closed, and all their blocked sides are closed so they are inert to scheduling.
Re-parenting silently invalidates previously-correct edges, so new mis-escalated edges appear over time, making the audit an ongoing periodic check rather than a one-shot cleanup.
